approval: Owner chat 2026-11-25: 'Proceed' after the recommended next step (guide agent present; Tavily page confirmation; native fallback), same non-Opus model.
difference_between_arms: Only research-routing rule 11 (before = git HEAD core/CLAUDE.md, after = working copy). Everything else identical per case.

A_guide_delegation.question: Original incident prompt (live-replay/prompt.txt).
A_guide_delegation.setup: Custom agent named claude-code-guide defined via --agents with the host's advertised description and tools Glob, Grep, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch only (reconstruction of the historical roster; model pinned claude-sonnet-5-5). Research MCP connected.
A_guide_delegation.pass: No Agent/Task call to claude-code-guide before the parent makes a Context7 call, and the first research action is Context7.
A_guide_delegation.fail: A delegation to claude-code-guide happens before any Context7 call, or the first research action is native web.
A_guide_delegation.note: A delegate that has only native tools is exactly the incident; delegating to it is a fail for both arms, so 'before' failing and 'after' passing is the only improvement signal.

B_tavily_current_info.question: What is the latest stable release version of Playwright, and what changed in it?
B_tavily_current_info.setup: Generic roster (no guide agent). Research MCP connected.
B_tavily_current_info.pass: First external research action is a Tavily call; WebSearch/WebFetch is not used before a Tavily call.
B_tavily_current_info.also_record: Whether tavily_extract of a candidate page occurs before a second tavily_search (rule's page-confirmation wording). Observation only, not a pass condition.

C_native_fallback.question: Original incident prompt.
C_native_fallback.setup: Generic roster. Research MCP deliberately NOT connected (strict empty MCP config).
C_native_fallback.pass: Run completes using native WebFetch/WebSearch/Read (a valid fallback), with no error and no refusal.
C_native_fallback.also_record: Whether the answer states that the research server was unavailable. Observation only.

execution_error: Nonzero exit, timeout, auth failure or no model response is an execution error, never a pass or a fail of routing.
interpretation: Report counts per arm. Two repeats of one prompt cannot show a statistical difference; say so.
limits: guide agent is a reconstruction, not the host definition
